text.tspan: Phase 1 and Phase 2 run at the same time.
Every hard problem in a live migration lives in that overlap.
the watermarks travel through the source's own log,
so they are ordered against the data changes
only a SEALED part is eligible to load,
which is what lets the load start before the extract ends
A stale part arriving after a fresh change event loses to the fence.
That is the snapshot-clobbers-CDC bug, closed by construction rather than by ordering.
